title: Real Inertia, Phase Obstructions, and de Rham Algebras for Orientifolds
summary: In this paper, we study de Rham realizations for finite orientifold quotients. On the orientation preserving inertia of an almost complex global quotient we construct an anti-linear involution of the Chen-Hu algebra whose fixed subalgebra is a real form of the Chen-Ruan algebra. For genuine orientation reversing fixed sectors we prove that no coordinate invariant single sector fractional age exists.
